boundaryDiscrepancy.officialHelpText: average of 60 one-second RTI readings in the expiration minute
boundaryDiscrepancy.explanation: The documented live accumulation interval and the payload [start, end) identity are two different 60-second intervals that differ at both endpoints. Official help describes 60 one-second readings, not a 5Hz mean and not a fitted offset. These are distinct concepts; a single matching average is not used to pick a boundary.
